title: Hurricane port conditions: Coast Guard closes Florida ports to vessel traffic under Port Condition ZULU
effect: When the Captain of the Port sets Port Condition ZULU before a storm, the Key West zone (§ 165.707) and the Sector Mobile zone, which covers the western Panhandle (§ 165.849), close to all vessel traffic except as authorized; in the Sector Miami zone (§ 165.706) all port waterfront operations are suspended. A dive boat leaving port during a storm closure is covered. These are not drawn: they apply to whole Coast Guard zones and only while a condition is set.
excerpt: Port Condition ZULU. The port is closed to all vessel traffic except as specifically authorized by the COTP.
full: § 165.706(c)(4): "Port Condition ZULU. All port waterfront operations are suspended, except final preparations that are expressly permitted by the COTP as necessary to ensure the safety of the ports and facilities." § 165.849: "Port Condition ZULU. Regulated areas are closed to all vessel traffic except those specifically authorized by the COTP."
scope: Sector Miami, Key West and Sector Mobile Captain of the Port zones.
note: Read 12 Nov 2026 in the author's Chrome on the eCFR renderer; §§ 165.706, 165.707 and 165.849 all carry version dates of 28 Sep 2026 (a Coast Guard nomenclature or consolidation change; § 165.849 was published at 91 FR 55479 on 28 Aug 2026). The excerpt is § 165.707(c)(4). Not a spearfishing rule; recorded so the map's federal layer is complete. Watch for broadcast notices to mariners when a storm approaches. Sector Jacksonville and Sector St. Petersburg sections were not found among the versions changed since May 2026 and were not read.
